mapRecords.note: Map of Tanirith and the Eastern lands. Crown: the Lord Paladine's castle; Shield: compound of the Knighthood of the Flame; Jewelry: High Town; Food: farms; Bottle: grapevine yards; Bracers: prison of Tarterys Island; Furfoot: Arvoranaan.

Hand-made map of the Heartlands.  Merchant: Aranys (annexed by Sharranth months ago); Mining iron spike: Sparklestone (occupied); Thief: Dagger Keep (occupied); Burning house: Wailsrond (under siege); Tent: last known enemy camp/position.

Hand-made map of the Western lands. Full-face helm: Sharranth; Horned helm: minotaur community; Merchant: Rock Forest (trade caravan waystation); Noble: Mountainside (barony); Cradle: Cedar Cove (village); Magic ring: strange mansion.
Partial map of the North-Eastern lands.  Royal soldier: Lantharond; Dragon: Dragonheart castle; Merchant: Creek Dale (trade caravan waystation); Amazon: amazon village of Artemisia Forest.
Partial map of the city of Umaldyr, capital of the Island Nation of Umaldyr. Camp: barracks of the Royal Militia; Crown: Royal Palace; Food: Central Market; X: other sites of interest.

Undermeet, the neutral area where diverse races meet in peace to trade. Gnome: quarters of earth gnomes; Shadow elf: quarters of the shadow elves; Kobold: kobold quarters; Dwarf: dark dwarven quarters; X: The Lightless Gloom (tavern, inn).
Robbard's map to the Portal of Dianchuur. The portal is marked by an "X"; secret doors are shown as well.
Location of some long, lost ruins in the Volcanic Khanark Rockies.
Cave in the Heartlands which leads to the Tlaran Caves and the Underearth.
Entrance to a passage leading to a crystal palace (marked by an "X"). The gates to a frost giant stronghold are also shown on the upper right of the map.
Sewer entrance to the headquarters of the Red Claw, an assassins' Guild. Two secret doors are shown as well.
Entrance leading to a lair of wererats.
Cavern supposedly leading to the new headquarters of Khraash, the orc Bandit Lord.
Map to a small archipelago in the Southern Ocean, where a sea serpent is rumored to lair.

Map you made while standing atop the northern lighthouse of Umaldyr, allowing you to spy the areas of the Northern Island closest to you. The 'X' marks the location of a strange crystal palace; Food: small fiefdom; Boat on dry dock: shipyards.
Map you made while standing atop the southern lighthouse of Umaldyr, allowing you to spy the areas of the Southern Island furthest from you. The 'X' marks the location of ancient stuctures.
Map of the northeastern area of the desert of Astaroth. Skull: cave of the Tribe of Murdor; 'X': caves of minor beastman tribes ruled by the Murdor.

Partial map of the Underearth surrounding Undermeet. "X": Undermeet; Shadow elf: Naaz'Tzaraneen; Dwarf: Greyshimmers; Kobold: Sseshathuur; Gnome: earth gnome fortifications; Skull: kobold maze (dangerous!).
House of the woodsman named Girond. He is to give you a password to allow you to meet with the leaders of the Unicorns, the rebel organization set to depose Anthraxus Storm.
General location of some ancient, forest-buried elven ruins.
